# Cambridge HVAC Pros

> Serving Cambridge and the wider Waterloo Region region, Cambridge HVAC Pros is a home comfort contractor covering furnace repair, air conditioner service, ductless installation, heat pumps, fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning for Ontario homeowners.

Phone: (519) 623-1847  |  Email: contact@cambridgehvacpros.ca  |  Website: https://cambridgehvacpros.ca

Service areas: Cambridge, Kitchener, Waterloo, Elmira, Listowel, New Hamburg, Baden, Breslau
